scope: Public v021 walkthrough, approved by the owner
limitations: Furniture opening disabled after reported instability. Static closed-furniture fallback; regression cause unconfirmed, not an interactive-storage fix. Stairs visual-only. Simplified materials; not construction approval. Rear OTS has provisional open metal grating at floor level with a shaft void below. Grating, supports, glass and roofing are not certified construction. Electronics are schematic proposals only. Washer is deferred by the user, not a batch blocker; no washer is modeled. Inverter/battery, AV receiver and outdoor AC units remain unplaced. No electrical or fire-safety certification. Existing-size aquarium on its own open frame; loaded floor/stand support and installation are not verified. Water/fish are illustrative. Glazed partition is a proposed wall alteration pending structural/site review. No tested AC/acoustic performance or electrical/thermal cabinet approval. Door is closable in the design but held open in the walkthrough. Front arched door/window assemblies follow user photos with source-plan widths; unmeasured elevations, frame/grille and glazing details are provisional. Exterior surroundings are not modeled. Proposed ceiling overlays preserve source beam cores and glazing and show five fan provisions. Suspension, service/driver access, fan capacity, detector locations, formed-profile manufacture and actual heights require professional/product verification. RO body and service envelopes are provisional, not certified product fit. No plumbing/electrical routes designed. Intermediate stair landing is a separate study, not connected to this floor. All bath-window elevations remain assumed. Opaque preview materials are not certified night/high-angle privacy. Fixed inserts and three exhaust/electric-geyser concepts require site/product/professional review; no service routes or structural openings are authorized.

variants.label: Quiet / beam-led
variants.summary: Shallow perimeter trays, soft indirect light and exposed original beams; calm bedrooms with no bright lights over pillows.

variants.label: Linear
variants.summary: Clean lowered fields with recessed light lines, aligned to the beam bays and room axes; the raised dining volume remains open.

variants.label: Warm gallery
variants.summary: Timber-look slatted accents in the hall/drawing room, restrained bedroom headboard bands, and plain easy-clean kitchen/wet-area ceilings.

variants.label: Sculpted flow
variants.summary: Connected beam-level ribbons with curved transitions, higher fan pockets, a sculpted dining lightwell and one TV-wall return. Original structural cores and glazing remain.

variants.label: Sculpted Luxe
variants.summary: Continuous mineral-plaster ceiling fields with broad elliptical recesses, concealed curved coves and closed, softly arched beam returns. No floating frames or brass outlines; structure, fan pockets and daylight remain.

ceiling_options.note: Whole-floor concepts with five static fan provisions. Sculpted Luxe adds floating curved layers and selective nonstructural beam casings without changing beam cores, fan pockets or the lightwell. Geometry, supports and installation remain provisional; browser lighting is simplified.

drawing_l_sofa.display_capacity: Width reduced from 1300 to 700 mm (about 46 percent less frontage); two selected pieces shown instead of four. Entire collection fit not claimed.
drawing_l_sofa.display_fronts: Two bypass-sliding glazing fronts; no outward swing into standing space. Approximately 315 mm clear retrieval aperture per half, product detailing pending.
drawing_l_sofa.comfort: Compact 1495 mm overall chaise, not a full-length daybed. Opposing sofa and 590 x 800 mm table size retained; entire table moves 250 mm east, preserving 455 mm facing-seat gaps and the east lane/stool retrieval.

bathroom_privacy.status: Proposed fixed infill within existing apertures; site elevations, glazing specification and neighbor sightlines unmeasured
caveats: All three apertures are treated as potentially overlooked from neighboring houses or roofs.
Existing modeled sill 1550 mm and head 2250 mm are provisional original defaults, not surveyed elevations. Structural opening sizes are not enlarged.

Fixed lower opaque infill protects direct body-height views. Small upper light-diffusing inserts are not clear glazing and must be selected/reviewed for night and high-angle privacy; frosted glass alone is not an absolute privacy guarantee.
Public GLB deliberately renders all privacy inserts OPAQUE, alpha 1, without transmission. This preview behavior is not a certified glazing performance test.
No opening window mode exposes bathers. Static exhaust concepts have closed sight-blocking dampers; airflow while running is not simulated.
Fans require product sizing for room volume, duct pressure loss, duty, noise, humidity/timer controls and maintenance. No verified outdoor outlet or shaft route is invented.
Short outward weatherhood/sleeve concepts require neighbor-opening, fire-separation, weather and site review. Never discharge into the ceiling void.
Makeup air must be designed with extraction. No unverified door undercut, fire-rated-door alteration or transfer grille is cut into existing geometry.

No gas unit, fictional socket, live indicator, energized connection, hot-water route, concealed circuit or discharge pipe is modeled.
